name: relocate
_comment: CONTROL, and the counterpart to `null`. The two rows of the trait dictionary are swapped WHOLE -- label, modality, table, unit and entity_level travel together -- so the dictionary states exactly the same facts, only in the other order. Nothing a correct derivation depends on has changed, so `legitimises` is null and the answer stands. What HAS changed is where the information sits. `null` asks whether attention moves when nothing relevant changed; `relocate` asks whether it follows content that moved. A method that fails either is not measuring content. Parity is exact by construction: this is a permutation of two lines, not a substitution.
